flex_score_cube

Source: R/technicals.R
flex_score_cube.Rd

utility function used by match_flex_params(). flex_score_cube() returns a table of flexibilty scores for a range \(\gamma,\tau\) pairs, given input values for \(\eta,\phi\). Flexibility is on a 1-hour measure.

flex_score_cube(eta_targ = 0.3, phi_targ = 0.6)

Arguments

eta_targ

\(eta\) parameter assumption

phi_targ

\(phi\) parameter assumption

Examples

flex_score_cube(0.3,0.3) #%>% dplyr::slice_max(flex_score)
#> # A tibble: 10,000 × 3
#>    gamma   tau flex_score
#>    <dbl> <dbl>      <dbl>
#>  1     2  6          3.63
#>  2     2  6.67       4.23
#>  3     2  7.33       4.83
#>  4     2  8          5.42
#>  5     2  8.67       6.02
#>  6     2  9.33       6.61
#>  7     2 10          7.21
#>  8     2 10.7        7.80
#>  9     2 11.3        8.40
#> 10     2 12          8.99
#> # ℹ 9,990 more rows
ff <-  flex_scores %>% dplyr::filter(eta==0.5,phi==0.6)
